item.title: Kathryn Mary Roof
item.description: Kathryn “Kady” Mary Roof, age 64, of LeRoy, Minnesota, passed away peacefully Sunday, January 25, 2026. She was surrounded by her loved ones at the time. Kady was born October 30, 1961, to Ronald and Sheila (Johnson) Roof in St. Paul, Minnesota. She grew up and attended school in the St. Paul area, later living in Hastings and LeRoy, Minnesota. item.title: Bittersweet Symphony: Rebels show their worth, but can’t close out No. 3 ranked NRHEG
item.description: Southland girls let a 16-point lead slip in a 58-57 loss to No. 3 NRHEG, but double-doubles from Koenigs and Matheis show the Rebels can contend with top-ranked foes.

item.title: PHOTOS: GOP, DFL head to local caucuses Tuesday night
item.description: Photos capture Minnesota caucus night as Austin’s DFL gathers at Ruby Rupner Auditorium and GOP supporters meet at Ellis Middle School and in Grand Meadow.

item.title: Kratom Extracts From Professor Whyte’s—A Trusted Name Among Buyers
item.description: Choosing Kratom Extracts from Professor Whyte’s means aligning with a brand recognized for consistency, clarity, and buyer-first standards.

item.title: J. Michael Enger
item.description: J. Michael Enger, 81, of Austin, Minnesota, passed away Monday, January 26, 2026 at The Cedars of Austin.

item.title: Mary Ann Falkenberg
item.description: Mary Ann Falkenberg, age 81, passed away peacefully in her home on January 13, 2026, in Burnsville, Minnesota, after a courageous battle with cancer. She was surrounded by love, grace, and the comfort of family and her Lord.

item.title: Hulne: Parental support is crucial for high school sports
item.description: After 20 years on the sidelines, a prep sports writer says the most important thing parents can do isn’t postgame coaching, but simply showing up and supporting their kids.

item.title: Renee Macklin Good's brothers, others call for ICE reforms at public forum
item.description: At a D.C. forum, relatives of Renee Macklin Good and other citizens describe violent encounters with federal immigration agents as Democrats urge ICE be defunded or abolished.

item.title: Men’s basketball: Gophers pull off huge upset of No. 10 Michigan State
item.description: Unranked Gophers stun No. 10 Michigan State 76-73 at Williams Arena, snapping a seven-game skid behind Jaylen Crocker-Johnson’s 22 points and balanced scoring from all five starters.

item.title: Packers shake off nerves to knock off Red Wing girls hockey team
item.description: Austin girls hockey rallies past Red Wing 6-2 in Section 1A quarterfinal, with Louks and Coddington scoring twice as the Packers advance to face top-seeded Dodge County.
